title: Unit tests for a provider appointment calendar
name: Provider calendar tests

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how these unit tests set up and isolate the state they check? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
In the "returns a copy" test, why does setting `slot.patientId = null` on the returned object not reopen the 10:00 slot?
choices: Because patientId is readonly on Slot
Because book() returns `{ ...slot }`, a shallow copy separate from the object stored in the map
Because available() re-reads slots from a database
Because the Date key changes after booking

questions.prompt: Patient pt-300 holds 9:30. Another caller invokes cancel(nineThirty, "pt-999"). What happens?
choices: The slot is freed, since any cancel on a booked slot frees it
cancel returns true but the slot stays booked
cancel returns false and the slot stays booked for pt-300

questions.prompt: openSlot is called for 9:00 with durationMin 60 after pt-100 has already booked the 30-minute 9:00 slot. What is the stored slot's state?
choices: Still 30 minutes and booked by pt-100, because openSlot ignores an existing key
60 minutes and unbooked, because the slot is replaced
60 minutes and still booked by pt-100
Two 9:00 slots exist, one booked and one open
